injury_predictions.name: RJ Harvey
injury_predictions.note: Short-term IR 10/31 (knee, hurt in practice 10/29). Must miss four games: Weeks 8, 9, 11, 12 (DEN bye Week 10). Eligible Week 13 vs MIA.
injury_predictions.source: AP via Washington Post/Fox Sports, NBC Sports (PFT), Yahoo (11/1)

injury_predictions.name: Lamar Jackson
injury_predictions.note: Right thumb injury on Baltimore's first offensive play of Week 8 vs BUF (first game back from the ankle). Minter: needs surgery and goes on IR, so he misses at least Weeks 9-12. Minter didn't know yet if it's season-ending; Week 13 is the earliest possible return.
injury_predictions.source: Jesse Minter via ESPN, Yahoo Sports, BaltimoreRavens.com (11/1)

injury_predictions.name: DeVonta Smith
injury_predictions.note: Hamstring setback: returned Week 6, then ruled out Week 7 and Week 8 vs WAS (DNP all week). Not on NFL IR. Week 9 is the earliest; Week 10 is a midpoint estimate given two setbacks, unconfirmed.
injury_predictions.source: PhillyVoice Week 8 injury report, CBS News Philadelphia
